newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Doman rating at B+(High).
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Doman rating at B+(High).

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service on Tuesday reaffirmed the rating of Doman Industries Ltd's senior unsecured notes at B+(High) but lowered its rating outlook to stable from positive.

The debt rating agency said the revision reflects the relatively limited liquidity support during the first half of 1996 and the anticipated maintenance of relatively high levels of debt leverage over the near- to mid-term.
CBRS said while Doman has been able to reduce its debt equity levels in each of the past five years, leverage remains relatively high for such a cyclical industry.

The agency said strong market conditions for the company's lumber and the improving prices for some of its pulp products should enable the company to improve the level of internally generated cash flow.
In the longer term, CBRS said Doman's relatively high debt leverage is expected to continue to moderate improvements in credit ratings.
